architecture.mechanism: The formation of interconnected gas porosity chains in ADC12 aluminum alloy during die casting is primarily caused by the entrapment of gases in the molten metal during solidification, particularly in thick sections where solidification fronts meet.
architecture.intervention: Modify the gating system to ensure turbulent-free filling of the mold cavity and implement a controlled solidification pattern through the use of chills in the thick-walled boss section.
architecture.expected_effect: Reduction in interconnected gas porosity formation by 40-60% in the critical wall junction area, decreasing helium leak test failure rate below 1%.
architecture.falsification_test: Compare helium leak test results between castings with modified gating/chill system and original design using statistical process control with 100 samples per condition.
